result:
Here are the 6 improvements added to v79.9:
1. Promptfoo: Enhanced prompt engineering capabilities for more accurate and efficient LLM interactions.
2. Semantic search: Introduced a semantic search feature to provide more relevant and contextual results.
3. Llm-client: Implemented a new LLM client for improved communication and integration with language models.
4. SSE reconnect: Added automatic reconnect functionality for Server-Sent Events (SSE) to ensure uninterrupted real-time updates.
5. LLM tracer: Developed an LLM tracer to track and analyze language model performance, identifying areas for optimization.
6. Cache analytics: Integrated cache analytics to monitor and optimize cache performance, reducing latency and improving overall system efficiency.
